About us

Ntobeko Wellness & Fitness is a holistic wellness brand that helps professional women live balanced lives.

We support women to reclaim themselves, reconnect with their bodies and thrive mentally, physically, emotionally, socially and spiritually.

Talk to us

Never late to Re-Start

Built for the woman who thinks she is left behind. For the one who tried before and stopped. For the one who feels ashamed to come back.

Mission & vision

What we are here to do.

Our mission

Transformative fitness, nutrition and mental wellness solutions that:

  • Promote long-term health over quick fixes
  • Address the unique needs of women's bodies
  • Inspire self-love and body confidence
  • Foster a sisterhood of accountability and healing

Our vision

To build a global community of self-loving women who feel seen, supported and unstoppable in their wellness journeys.

What we offer

Five ways to start, each built around you.

Fitness Programs

Tailored strength, mobility and cardio routines for women at every fitness level, with a focus on hormonal health and longevity.

Contact us for packages

Nutrition Coaching

Practical, nourishing eating plans that support your energy and balance. Not restriction, not dieting.

Contact us for packages

Mind-Body Healing

Guided journaling and mindset coaching to heal emotional wounds and manage stress, anxiety and burnout.

Contact us for packages

Hikes & Retreats

In-person wellness experiences focused on self-care, inner healing and feminine power.

Contact us for packages

Online Coaching & Community

A safe, supportive space with daily motivation, expert support and sisterhood to help you stay consistent and thrive.

Contact us for packages

What we stand for

Four values guide everything we do.

Empowerment

We help women rise and reclaim their bodies, stories and confidence.

Holistic wellness

We look after mind, body and soul together.

Sustainability

Sisterhood

How it works

Four steps. You are never on your own.

1

Consultation

We learn about your needs and goals.

2

A personalised wellness plan, because one size doesn't fit all.

3

Guided start

Step-by-step guidance helps you begin strong.

4

Active coaching

Weekly check-ins, live sessions and community support keep you consistent.

Meet the founder

Ntobeko Mkhulisi, Founder & Director

In her 20s, Ntobeko chased financial success, believing money would fix everything. In her 30s she learned that financial wellness cannot exist without mental, physical, social and spiritual wellness.

Today she leads with one belief: it is never late to re-start.

“I don’t help people chase success. I help them rebuild the foundation that can sustain it.”
